name: Rei (XR)
tagline: The prime coin: supply up the primes, one account with everything
summary: Rei (零), ticker XR, is the coin the whole system is denominated in. Supply steps up the prime numbers and is shared by Riemann's R function; it launches on an XR/USD book on MIAX, in the same account as the stock perps.

name: American Perpetual
tagline: The rail: perpetuals on everything, cleared at OCC, 60% of the fees
summary: Perpetual futures on 101 US stocks and ETFs on MIAX Futures, cleared at OCC, under a licence that pays American Perpetual LLC 60% of the fees MIAX collects on every perpetual product. Filings drafted; signing set final 30 Sep 2026.

name: Asset classes
tagline: One rail, every asset: crypto, FX, metals, world indices
summary: After equities the same build lists crypto (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP), then FX with gold and silver, then foreign indices, each needing only a new reference feed and a multiplier, all under the same royalty.

name: The street
tagline: Market makers, brokers and the app that carry the product
summary: Launch partners, the market-maker program, the Robinhood screens, the FCM build and the integrator kit: four inputs, four booking rules, one screen and one report line at every firm.

name: The desk
tagline: Trading: the terminal, the break list, the funded account
summary: Where the vision trades: the terminal (setups by timeframe from OI/mcap, funding, breakouts, Korea flow and depth), the Hyperbull break list, and the adjacent arbitrage bets.

name: GLX / Greyline
tagline: The equity-perp exchange build that became American Perpetual
summary: Six business models in seven months, from basket perps to a licence on MIAX's fee pool. Its product mechanics, relationships and IP carried into American Perpetual.

name: Capital & IP
tagline: Who owns which point of the royalty, and what stays outside
summary: The royalty's buyers and the IP line: Silver Lake's June package, the planned 10% secondary, and the five ventures kept outside the IP assignment in June.

name: Origins
tagline: The coin, the fund and the first exchange sketches, 2021–2025
summary: Manifest, the main coin over product coins, the Z stablecoin, Andromeda and its fund successors, the market tools and the media bets. The lineage Rei inherits.
